title: After Buddy Petit died: joining Chris Kelly
summary: The band fell apart without Petit, so Penn began playing with Chris Kelly, who also advertised in the streets.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band

blocks.x: a drummer. Well what happened to Buddy's band after he took that second stroke? What actually happened with the band?

Well, what happened to the band, we just played a while and didn't get much work. What we used to get when Buddy was living. So the men began to drop out. In fact, Buddy was well known and Buddy used to get plenty of work. So after he died, the fellas just dropped out and got in other different bands. So that's why I went and started playing with Chris Kelly a while.
